title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP progamme component 2 in Ethiopia focuses specifically on the dairy value chain and will be implemented in Oromia and Amhara regions. 2,000 households (12,000 beneficiaries) will be targeted. The programme will support use of Artificial insemination to enhance the genetics of local breeds and will train Artificial Insemination technicians. Vaccination and treatment will be provided to improve animal health. Nurseries will be established for the supply of seedlings for forage and fodder. Farmers will be trained in backyard forage production and management as well as in enhanced use of crop residues. The programme will support improved access to water supply for dairy cooperative centres and will build the capacity of cooperatives to collectively manage the collection of milk and to conduct milk hygiene testing. Cooperatives will also be trained in cooperative management, marketing, andbusiness plan development and will be linked with local milk processing unions.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 2: Equitable and inclusive food systems to support availability, access and consumption of safe nutritious food. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Activities to promote access to nutritious foods
